name: Effect Fill Swatches
description: Procedural GPU Effect fills evaluated as scape3d mesh textures. Boards A-D (codex): environment, condemned, props/wearables, neon-rot interiors. Boards E-F (Claude): the neon-surface dream pole and contraband/crime-scene game-objects. Board G (Kimi): liminal threshold surfaces. Board H (Kimi): second-pass environment alts — asphalt, sidewalk, stone wall, dune, deep water, turf, plank deck. Each material x3 variants x a runtime detail grade (PSX -> Max). See CATALOG.md.
